bullets.content: [general] One change per solve, then compare(prev,new) of two DIFFERENT solves (compare(a,a) is noise) and read regions[0..2]. Use all 4 solves when error is within ~5% of target: baseline, edge refinements, coarser h (1.3x) keeping local sizes, best. Submit smallest change per extra DOF.

[general] One change per solve (h OR one refinement target); a1's solve 3 changed h and added f20 together, so its 19% diff is unattributable. Use all 4 solves (a1 stopped at 3; a0 stopped with last diff 10.5%): solve 4 = best guess plus hotspot fix, compare(3,4), submit by error per DOF.

[general] solve() runs on the LAST mesh() call. Never probe meshes right before a solve: a1's solve 4 landed on the h 0.1 mesh (quality 0.088, invalid). Re-issue the chosen mesh call immediately before solve; check node counts match.

[general] Pick submission by compare between materially different meshes, not the reference-free estimate. a0 submitted solve 2 (estimate 14.3%, true 18.6%); compare(2,4)=16.6% meant the clamp needed a finer check.

[general] Keep promises: list each (edge-only solve, no full-thickness box, re-mesh if DOFs >14-16k or quality <0.12) and tick off before every mesh/solve. a0 promised <=16k DOFs and 0.12 but submitted 21k and 0.110. Re-mesh, or justify with score arithmetic.

[general] After each solve read the 5 hotspots (local h, nearest face/edge) and view(kind=error); refine the face/edge nearest each hotspot to ~half its local h (a1 refined f23 not the junction rims). Field error binds over check-point RMS; the estimator under-reads 1.2-1.5x.

[general] Compare diff to a mesh 1.1-1.4x finer approximates the coarser mesh's error (19% vs true 20.7%; 10.5% vs 10.5%); under-reads ~10%. Last diff >16% means the 2x target is missed: spend the last solve on hotspot refinement. Estimator under-reads.

[general] When successive compare diffs barely fall (20% then 17%), the last diff approximates true error. Diff 14.3% between near-identical meshes under-read true 18.6% (~1.3x): any diff >12% means target missed; spend remaining solves on hotspot bands.

[general] Pick submission by compare(candidate, finest), hotspot local h and refined groups actually refined; don't pick by strain energy when energies differ <2.5%. Never use remembered values. If DOFs differ >30% at similar error, submit cheaper.

[general] Score arithmetic before buying DOFs: score ~ 1/(e*DOFs) above target; break-even e2=e1*sqrt(c2/c1) below. From 10.5% at 21k, +3k DOFs must give e<9.2%, +1.5k <9.8%. 13.2% at 22.4k scored 0.33 vs 12.4% at 13.8k scoring 0.60. Coarsen zero-error regions.
[general] Name the binding term first: field error binds over point RMS when RMS is lower. Compare diffs to a slightly finer mesh tracked true error well; the hotspot estimate under-read it.

[general] After every mesh read the touching-h table for every hotspot-adjacent group: refined groups must reach <=0.6x median h, else re-request smaller before solving. Use {edge}/{group} if a box leaves cells >= median h. Map edge tags via inspect_geometry.

[general] Realised local size is 1.2-1.75x the request (f16 asked 0.0035 got 0.00547; f2 asked 0.003 got 0.00429). Request ~0.7x the target and re-mesh without solving until the size table is within 1.1x.

[general] Local size 2.5-3x below global h; box radius >=3.3x size (0.0026 needs r>=0.009). Boxes on thin curved walls gave quality 0.066-0.11 while group/edge fields gave 0.17-0.22. Re-mesh (free) until quality>=0.12; never solve <0.1.

[general] Size field is non-monotone: adding {edge 40,0.0026} cut nodes (8437→8121) and quality to 0.112. Read nodes and quality.min after each mesh (re-mesh if <0.12). If h 0.009 with box 0.003 r 0.006 fails (0.0986), widen r>=0.008. Don't raise global h: 0.012 coarsened junction rims.

[general] Node count and quality.min are non-monotone in global h (h 0.045 q 0.134; 0.06 q 0.058; 0.08 q 0.083; 0.1 q 0.088). Sweep 3-4 h values one mesh call at a time, log nodes and quality, solve the fewest-node mesh with q>=0.12.
[general] Identical recipes tie and earn no hidden-point bonus. Vary structure (order, h >1.5x different e.g. 0.045 vs 0.03, group vs box-only targets) while staying within 90% of best score.
[general] Score arithmetic: at 23.4k DOFs (c=3.86) even hitting the 15.9% target scores only ~0.26. Coarsen zero-error regions (caps f15/f25, mid-tube) first; aim 14-18k DOFs and test in one solve.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction rims z 0.020-0.031, |x| 0.013-0.021 hold ~26% of error (h 0.0045-0.0054). Use edges 8/39 AND +x boss rim edge (tag via inspect_geometry) at 0.0022 r 0.007, f19 0.0026 r 0.006, f16 0.0025 r 0.005. Need f16/f19 touching <=0.0035.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Tube flanks |y| 0.008-0.0185 hold 25-37% of error (wall one element thick). Group f20 0.0028/f23 0.003 r 0.004 works (quality 0.2) but puts >5,600 elements over mid-tube z 0.005-0.02 (error already <3%): prefer bands to cut DOFs from 23k toward 14-18k.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Cover tube wall continuously z -0.001..0.0605: gap z 0.037-0.048 (hotspot #6, h 0.00685) needs one box ~0.0035 or bands overlapping >=0.004; bottom end z 0-0.006 near f22 (350% local error) start box at z -0.001, request 0.0032 or {group f22,0.003,r 0.004}.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Keep {group f16} in every recipe (737 mm²): cut check point +43%→-2.5%, RMS 14.8%→6.85% (8.4% later), won hidden bonus. Request 0.0025 (0.0035 realised 0.0055). Leave caps f15/f17/f25 and boss tubes coarse.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Don't shrink global h (0.0042 gave 16.1% at 27.7k). Bosses/caps have near-zero error: raise h to 0.012-0.014 and let wall/rim refinements carry DOFs (h 0.009→0.012 with f20 cost only +3.2k DOFs).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a0 winning group recipe (quality 0.199, best-point bonus): h 0.014 order 2, f20 0.0036 r 0.005, f23 0.004 r 0.005, f16 0.0028 r 0.006, f19 0.0032 r 0.005, edges 8/39 0.0028, edge 40 0.0025 r 0.006. Add clamp ring box 0.0026 r 0.009. Peer a1: edges 8/39 0.0022, f20 0.0028.

[abc_00000003_bc7] a0 re-meshed rather than solving when quality <0.1 and used view(error, y/x) after solve 1 to locate the clamp and junction bands. Mesh calls are free: iterate until quality>=0.12 and touching-h targets are met.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Tube wall ~2.5 mm (outer r 17.2, bore 14.7 mm) is spanned by one 3.8-4.7 mm quadratic tet; diffuse bending (230 hotspots=80%). Realised size in wall must be <=0.0028 where error is high; global h barely controls it.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Scaling: 31.9%@6.1k (0.25), 18.1%@25.3k (0.185), 21.5%@23.0k (0.144); error ~N^-0.4, score falls with DOFs. Move DOFs into flank/clamp wall, coarsen rest; spend one solve on a 9-13k mesh vs ~20k.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Point RMS is dominated by P1, a low-stress point near the clamp (4.2 MPa, -43%). Fix the clamp band before tuning flank points (already within 1-7%).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Diversity (one solve): no f20/f23 groups; h 0.012, clamp ring 0.0026 r 0.009, junction box [-0.022,-0.0185,0.017,0.022,0.0185,0.035] size 0.0034 r 0.012, edges 8/39/40 0.0022. Submit if better error per DOF.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] 4 solves: 1) h 0.012 + f16/f19 0.0025 + edges 8/39 0.0022; 2) add f20/f23 wall, compare(1,2), view error; 3) coarser h keeping local sizes, compare(2,3); 4) best. Submit by compare plus hotspot h.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup verified by teacher and solves: 3d, E=210e9, nu=0.3, fixed f2, 4.0e6 on f23, 2.1e6 on f16, no gravity; energy 0.0328-0.0334 J. Error is discretisation; spend no solves on setup.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp-foot band z -0.0081..-0.0055, x 0.019-0.027 holds ~31-60% of error; strip realised 0.003 at 0.0022 request. Strip [0.0175,-0.013,-0.0081,0.0285,0.011,-0.0055] request 0.0016-0.0018 r>=0.006; touching h<=0.0025, quality>=0.11. Never coarsen to 0.003.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep edge 22 at 0.0016-0.0018 r 0.006 (not relaxed to 0.003). Re-entrant edge 115 is 17-24 mm from hotspots, not binding.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Fine full-thickness boxes are costly (0.0048 box: 7463 vs 5583 nodes), but a coarse wide one is fine (0.0048 r 0.015 over z -0.006..0.0081: +263 nodes, q 0.122). Judge each box by node delta from a free mesh call.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Upper-wall buffer is cheap: [0.014,-0.025,-0.006,0.03,0.014,0.0081] at 0.0042-0.0048 r 0.015-0.016 covered hotspots at z 0.005-0.008 (+263 nodes, estimate 12.8%→9.3%). Reach f38 hotspot (y 0.02) touching <=0.0045.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Quality: size 0.0025 r 0.006 in h 0.016 gave 0.073; 0.0048 r 0.008 in h 0.018 gave 0.083 (invalid). Keep r >=3.3x size, with 0.0045-0.005 buffer box r 0.01 around sizes <=0.003.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Upper wall/arm near f13, f7 (x 0.011-0.023, y -0.017..-0.006, z 0.004-0.006) is unconverged (11-13% of change). Extend wall box to ymin -0.025, add {edge 18,0.0022,r 0.007} or box over f13 at 0.004 r 0.012; f13 touching is 0.0059.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Inner face f5 touching h 0.0061 (1.5x median) next to hotspots #1,#4,#5 (~20% of error). One-change solve: {group f5,0.0035,r 0.01} or shift wall box xmin to 0.012; target f5 touching <=0.0042.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] x<0 half and top/far faces (f1,f3,f6,f52) carry ~no error: test h 0.022 vs 0.016 with identical arm refinements; keep coarser if compare diff <3%. a1: 13.8k DOFs matched 23.7k energy. Target 11-14k DOFs.
